target_customer: Procurement and compliance teams at large Brazilian enterprises
problem: Onboarding and approving suppliers (homologation) is slow, manual and document heavy.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for supplier relationship management

founders.name: Cirdes Henrique
founders.background_notes: YC page: founder and CTO, organizer of Tropical on Rails.

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating tax, banking and document data from official Brazilian sources and ERP integrations is standard engineering with integration work.

defensibility.rationale: ERP integrations and a network of connected suppliers (site claims 650,000) raise switching costs; the claim is the company's own.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The company's site presents Ariba and Coupa as integration partners, not rivals.

market_need_then: Large Brazilian buyers needed to vet many suppliers for tax and compliance status; the company later claimed homologation time fell from 42 to 8 days at one customer (own site).

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain B2B, tagline about supplier management on autopilot

branding.community_and_virality: A 2023 Forbes Brasil article framed it as aiming to be the Serasa of suppliers.

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand specific evidence beyond one Forbes Brasil feature and customer logos.

outcome_analysis: Linkana stayed small in funding but built an enterprise customer base in Brazil, with its site citing 200 plus procurement customers, 1,500 users and ISO 27001. No public round larger than accelerator money was found, so capital efficiency is the likely story, though funding is unverified.
notes: Funding found only on aggregators (CB Insights about $200K, Caplight $162K, another $261K; accelerator investors Latitud, Google for Startups, FIEMG Lab, Oxigenio) and is not recorded as rounds. A Caplight headline about a $16M Series A refers to another company. No competitor with a date near 2020 found; directory comparison pages are undated and excluded. Founding year 2018 per YC page, 2019 in another profile. About page returned 404. Downgraded to depth 1 by orchestrator: the researcher reported that the branding search was shared with other searches.
